correctness.rationale: All 126 five-vertex subsets are classified by exact graph connectivity; the resulting 77 facets generate exactly 203 faces. The packaged matching contains 88 disjoint Hasse-cover pairs. Full orientation of every Hasse cover, with matched arrows reversed, is acyclic. The only critical cells are one 0-cell and 25 3-cells, so Forman theory gives a wedge of 25 three-spheres. Euler characteristic -24 independently agrees with this homotopy type.
